posts.title: Fall in the valley: where to find local food this October
posts.alt: Shoppers browsing produce stalls at an outdoor farmers market
posts.excerpt: The Salida market runs through October 24, the winter market opens in November, and fall CSA and beef-share season is here. A quick guide to eating local as the season turns.
posts.body:
Frost is on the pumpkins, but Chaffee County's food season isn't over. Here's where to find local food in the weeks ahead. Everything below was checked against each farm's or market's own website on October 3, 2026.

Markets

  • Salida Farmers Market runs Saturdays 9 am to noon through October 24 at Alpine Park (404 E Street). (Source: Foodshed Alliance)
  • When it closes, the Chaffee County Winter Farmers Market takes over: Saturdays 10 am to 1 pm, November 14 to December 19, at the Chaffee County Fairgrounds. (Source: Foodshed Alliance)
  • In Buena Vista, The Lettucehead Food Company stocks Colorado-grown food year-round: Monday to Saturday 9 to 6, Sunday 10 to 4, at 545 US Hwy 24 N. (Source: thelettucehead.com)

Sign up now for later

  • Rocky Mountain Garlic has its 2026 Fall CSA sign-up open, plus this year's garlic varieties in its online shop.
  • Headwater Farms' 2026 full-season CSA sold out. Join its newsletter to hear when next season's sign-ups open.
  • Mushroom Love Co offers a limited mushroom CSA, along with growing supplies and classes.

Stock the freezer

Fall is when many ranches sell beef in bulk. Hutchinson Ranch takes grass-fed beef orders by phone or email. Browse every ranch on the Beef & Meat map.

Delivered from the San Luis Valley

Valley Roots Food Hub delivers produce, meat, cheese and eggs to Salida and Buena Vista. Orders are due Monday at 4 pm for Thursday delivery.

Pumpkin season: Guidestone Colorado lists its 20th annual Pumpkin Patch & Harvest Festival on guidestonecolorado.org. Check there for this year's dates and hours.

Know a farm stand or fall event we missed? Add it to the directory.

posts.title: Every free meal and pantry in Chaffee County, in one place
posts.alt: Rows of young vegetable plants being watered in a greenhouse
posts.excerpt: With SNAP benefits uncertain for many families, we turned the county's food-access flyer into a page you can search, filter by day and print, and re-checked each listing.
posts.body:
Last fall, a one-page flyer collected Chaffee County's free meals, pantries and food boxes. It was a great resource, but as an image it couldn't be searched, read aloud by a screen reader, or easily updated.

Our new Food Assistance page has the same information as a schedule you can filter by day, map and print. We also re-checked each listing against the organization's own website where one exists.

What's open, at a glance

  • Every day, 24/7: Guidestone Colorado's Free Community Fridge, behind A Church at 419 D St, Salida.
  • Buena Vista: Ark Valley Christian Mission pantry, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday 11 am to 2 pm, 122 Cottonwood Ave (confirmed on the mission's site).
  • Salida: pantries at The Grainery, Caring & Sharing and First Presbyterian Church most weekdays, and community meals Monday, Tuesday and Thursday. See the full schedule.
  • First Wednesday of each month: food box drive-through at the Salida Community Center, 305 F St.

What changed

First Presbyterian's own website now lists its Thursday pantry as 1 to 3:30 pm, not the 1 to 4 pm on last year's flyer. We couldn't reach the Caring & Sharing or Grainery websites when we checked, so those times come from the flyer. Please call ahead.

How you can help

Pantries need money, volunteers and food, especially fresh produce and protein. The Chaffee County Community Foundation's safety-net fund is the easiest place to start. Growers: ask a pantry about taking your extras.
